params.prompt: Typography-free overhead editorial illustration of an uninhabited market-week strategy desk, arranged as a clear clockwise visual ritual. In the center, exactly three warm-cream thesis cards show only large abstract up-or-down arrow icons, six colored confidence pips, geometric reasoning sketches, and movable evidence tabs. Around them, four pictogram stations form a continuous arc: sunrise disk with three yellow tokens; magnifying glass with evidence clippings; balance scales beside unlabeled benchmark lines; receipt pictogram feeding into a looping rematch arrow. High-contrast charcoal ink on warm-cream paper, hand-inked contours, subtle risograph grain, cinematic collage, clean geometric silhouettes, electric market-yellow and gain-green accents with tiny restrained red details, warm rim light, deep graphic shadows. Premium fintech game hero, coherent top-down composition, generous edge breathing room, crisp at web size. Strictly zero alphabetic characters, words, numerals, logos, watermarks, signatures, brands, or human figures anywhere.
